name: The Lottery Corporation Limited
summary: Headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, The Lottery Corporation Limited is an Australian enterprise dedicated to managing lottery and keno businesses. It delivers its offerings under the widely recognized "The Lott" and "Keno" brands. The company leverages an expansive distribution network comprising approximately 7,200 physical retail points, in addition to its digital channels, to reach its clientele. Established in 1881, this entity was formerly identified as Tattersall's Holdings Limited.
